title: Independently audit PR6353 rational joint basis and public boundary
body:
## Result
Independently checks PR #6353's frozen nine-output joint basis over Q. Separate forward and backward implementations agree on every entry of the 770×770 public transfer matrix (874 nonzero coefficients). The primary checker also binds the actual dual preparation, all nine anchor identities, 19 response rows, response bridge and inverse suffix.

The nine dual preparation rows are zero. The added **forward** CLEAR rows are nonzero scalar functionals; the proof and receipts explicitly separate these facts. This finite scalar audit establishes no physical erasure permission, native-phase/all-column admission, complete caller/invoice, κ or multiplication theorem.

## Evidence
- Python 3.12.14 registered replay passes normally and optimized.
- Six primary controls reject; four independently checked literal omissions produce concrete unequal coefficients.
- Read-only Git-free replay with empty executable PATH passes; six source-corruption and two typed-receipt controls reject.
- Committed bytes/modes, declared source ancestry and self-contained export checks pass.
- Canonical main refreshed: `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`; selected6030 and priority8 unchanged. 321-open-PR pagination and visible handoffs rechecked; coverage is non-atomic and incomplete for historical/Discussion content.

Scope, reproducible commands, remaining obligations and source pins are in `research/p104-joint-output-basis-audit/`. Publication tree matches the locally verified tree byte for byte. Hosted CI and maintainer acceptance remain separate.

Construction credit remains with Ali Romman, PR6349/6348/6350, DreamingOfClouds, Cinna Davis and the complete retained NOTICE chain. New independent audit: ToikY with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and three bounded subagents.

No selected-frontier change. Maintainer edits disabled.
